inputs.text: [excited] Smy… loh… don. In Greek, "smilo" means knife, and "odon" means tooth. [proud] The knife tooth.
[happily] That's its nickname, but it wasn't a tiger — [serious] and it didn't live with the dinosaurs either. It showed up way later, in the Ice Age, [pauses] a million years ago.
[confident] North and South America, in the cold, [warmly] right alongside the Dire Wolf.
